title: Browser scenarios: run a pump, switch the mode, axe scan
goal: The main controls work in a real browser and pass an accessibility scan
acceptance: A pump run shows waiting/running and ends off
A mode switch reaches the agent
An axe scan of the dashboard, map and setup pages finds no serious or critical issue
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: 2 h agent; axe findings that need UI fixes may add time and are proposed first.
